financings_after_balance_sheet.what: Underwritten public offering of 15,790,000 common shares at $28.50 per share
financings_after_balance_sheet.quote: The Company issued 15,790,000 shares of common stock at an offering price of $28.50 per share. The aggregate purchase price paid by investors was $450.0 million and the Company received net proceeds of $429.0 million
